title: Tunable 2D bimetallic NiCo-MOFs with engineered crystals for high-performance supercapacitors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00350H, Paper
Abdul Kareem, Aya Ali, Mahmoud M. Kaid, Hani M. El-Kaderi, Ali S. Alnaser, Oussama M. El-Kadri
Bimetallic NiCo-MOFs are grown in situ on nickel foam and their supercapacitor activity is investigated in three- and two-electrode configurations.
